title: What It Really Costs to Own a Ferrari Enzo
description:
A Ferrari Enzo costs about three point six million dollars to buy, according to Hagerty. But what does it really cost to own one? Not what the internet guesses, but what our sources can actually support. This video separates the numbers that come with a source from the ones that do not, builds a labelled scenario, and shows where nobody has the data. Our sources are Hagerty's valuation page, Sports Car Market, RM Sotheby's catalogue pages, Wikipedia, evo, The Drive, a PistonHeads listing and the Italian site Italpassion. We also quote one website, Gearshifters, whose figures have no sources, and we mark them as unverified. Our own arithmetic is always labelled.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
